_game: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening (Switch 2019), 01006BB00C6F0000
_source: Per-build memory addresses for Link's Awakening (build 909E904AF78AC1B8), derived from the game's code and checked against the running game.
_layout: PlayerStatus PS = main+0x1CC06E0; story flag N = bit N&7 of main+0x1CC0FE0+(N>>3); player transform T = [[[main+0x1C97188]+0x4B8]+0x80], position T+0xB0

health._v: observed: 80 quarter hearts = 20 hearts; 72 after a bomb

songs._v: b0 Ballad b1 Mambo b2 Frog (observed: 7)

bombs._v: observed: 99 -> 59 after a bomb (cheat save; cap 30/60)

equip_y._v: Y slot code, 0xFF empty; observed: menu + direct write

equip_x._v: X slot code, 0xFF empty; observed: direct write refreshed HUD

last_field_x._v: PS+0xC4 last overworld pos (map pin source indoors)

zone_id._v: camera zone (observed: 40 Tal Tal Heights, 2275 Dampe's shack)

dungeon._v: 0-7 Lv1-8, 8 Chamber, 9 Color, 255 none (observed in game)

g_paused_byte._v: 1 while the title/file-select/pause-menu modal system is active; 0 through a cutscene (confirmed in game)

level_name._v: slot holds &PS; PS+0 = level name (observed in game)

pos_x._v: Link position (observed in game); 0 during level loads

pos_y._v: Link position (observed in game); 0 during level loads

pos_z._v: Link position (observed in game); 0 during level loads

ps_slot._v: holds &PS; its address is GetMaxHealth's x0

dun_items._v: rec(i)+1 b0 compass b1 map b2 beak b3 boss key

dun_visited._v: rec(i)+8 visited rooms, bit = row*8+col (observed in game)

cur_dun_keys._v: current dungeon record; valid only when dungeon != 255

pin_x._v: pin i x (N_MapCore_00 units), stale when the kind is 0

ui_slot._v: UiMgr (main+0x1C971C0) slot table, s32 id of a live UI, -1 free; id 15 = Gm_Map (overworld map screen / pause Map tab / Memories / picker)

derived.name: game_map_open
derived._v: number of UI slots holding Gm_Map (0 / 1)

derived.name: dialogue_active
derived._v: ui_slot id 36 (Cm_Message) resident -- g_paused_byte does NOT cover this (confirmed 0 throughout the opening cutscene)

derived.name: pin_map_taps
derived._v: pin pane open AND Show all: the Map widget's tap_enabled_bind

derived.name: pin_panel_open_here
derived._v: @flag:pin_panel AND dgn_not_in_dungeon -- the pin pane cannot render or block input while dungeon content shares this page

derived.name: any_menu_open
derived._v: g_paused_byte OR dialogue_active -- ONE stable signal across a pause-tab change, replacing an OR of 8 individual ui_slot ids (flickered on device)
